what: Once past 20% from the screen bottom, a mask with a soft edge (panel 300%, middle third a gradient) sweeps sideways over 4 seconds so text and photos are revealed smearing in from the left. With look: down it goes top to bottom · with look: diagonal it goes diagonally from the top left, lifting together as it clears over 2 seconds

options.look: for down, it wipes away top→bottom (vertical text), for seep, it seeps out from the top with a narrow edge while opacity also goes 0→1 (length default 2, ease-in-out — Hotel), for diagonal, a 135° edge from top-left→bottom-right passes in 2s (cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1)) while opacity also goes 0→1 over 1.5s ease (Coffee shop), default is left→right · for grow, a blurred mask stuck to the left grows 100%→300% and spreads, opaque in the first 20% (3.4s cubic-bezier(.26,1,.48,1) — Car brand) · for round, a blurred round mask at the center grows 0%→500%, opaque in the first 30% (4s — Car brand) · for band, the top 40% or so is transparent and a wide blurred band curving high on the left (panel 100%×600%) moves 0→100%, revealing by seeping in (2s sine.out cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1) — Brand) · for wave, a wavy blurred edge rises from below as the panel widens 100%×300% → 300%×200% (4.5s cubic-bezier(.11,.58,.26,1.01)) and opacity runs 1.5s linear, the inner [data-fx-part=photo] resolves from 1.1x scale and 4px blur over 2s (Brand brush stroke) · corner mode — a round blurred edge (panel 200%×100%) spreading from the top-right corner passes from -100% to 100% so the image is revealed from the left, and at 767px and below it becomes a straight edge, transparent on the left → opaque in the center (3s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1) — Brand photo reveal) · cloud mode — a square mask with a wavy blurred edge (opaque on top, transparent below) grows from height 200%→500% while moving from the bottom end to the top end, spreading like mist from top to bottom, opaque in the first 20% (1.8s cubic-bezier(0,.4,.48,1) — Brand photo) · rise mode — a wavy blurred edge (transparent on top, opaque below, the left side slightly higher) moves across a 100%×460% panel from the top end to the bottom end, spreading upward from below with opacity unchanged (3.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) — Brand photo and veil) · ink mode — a square mask with an ink-bleed edge (transparent on top, opaque below) grows from height 200%→500% while moving from the top end to the bottom end, bleeding upward from below like ink, opaque in the first 20% (5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) — Brand photo and sub-page header photo) · slash mode — a 110° diagonal edge with no blur (panel 256%×110%) passes from the right to the left end so the photo is revealed as if erased diagonally, opaque from the first 1% (1s cubic-bezier(.87,0,.13,1) — Brand photo .fadeClip, margin: 0) · half mode — a narrow horizontal mask (panel 300%) with its edge between 1/3 and 1/2 from the left passes from the right end to the left end, wiping open from the left (2.5s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) — Brand photo maskopen, curve changed to ease)
options.margin: How far up from the bottom of the screen before it starts, default 20 (0 means as soon as visible)
options.offset: How many px the section must rise from the bottom of the screen to start (if given, used instead of margin) — Brand 100
options.on: If manual, it does not start on scroll and spreads when fx:play is sent (to match the choreography order, like the hero title)
options.back: If true, when it leaves the bottom of the screen again it returns to its initial state and spreads again next time (Brand A: is-show when it enters, removed when scrolled back up) · if both, once fully off screen either above or below it returns to its initial state and spreads again (Brand B onLeave·onLeaveBack)
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: (look: wave) Inner photo released together — 1.1x scale · blur 4px → in place over 2s
options.ease: (look: round · rise) Curve — a CSS name or four cubic-bezier numbers, default round 0.26,1,0.48,1 · rise 0.16,1,0.3,1 — Brand ease
options.fade: (look: round) with none only the size grows, with full it goes 0→1 over the whole length. The default is opaque over the first 30%
options.at: With center it spreads when the element’s middle touches the bottom of the screen (instead of margin·offset — the original start "50% bottom")

note: The original used a grainy gradient PNG as a mask — here a linear-gradient gives the same size and the same movement (no grain)
